summary: Alphabet Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a public offering of 25,459,689 shares of Class A common stock and 25,459,689 shares of Class C capital stock at respective public prices of $355.1982 and $351.8018 per share, expected to close on June 4, 2026. Concurrently, it is offering $16.75 billion in mandatory convertible preferred stock via two series of depositary shares. Underwriters include Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan, and Morgan Stanley. No special-situation event is described; this is a routine capital-raising transaction.
